_meta.description: JenniNexus brand token map for pdf-designer resume/cover-letter exports. Purple/pink/turquoise on deep purple-black, with aurora-gradient headings.
_meta.source: The JenniNexus brand. Dark tokens are the brand's own; the light counterpart is derived here for white paper. Self-contained on purpose — a tracked file must not depend on a private path to be understood.

_paletteRuleNote: HOUSE RULE: no brown, no mustard, no puke/lime green. The dark 'gold' token (fff06b, a bright yellow at hue ~55deg) has NO readable dark form on white paper — darkening it for print drives it into mustard, then brown. Per the rule, on LIGHT the gold role is handed to ANOTHER HUE from the palette: the deep blue 1d5fa8. Blue was chosen over teal because the support token already occupies the teal band (00806a, hue ~170deg) and the gold role needs to stay visually distinct. Do NOT 'fix' the light gold back to a dark yellow — that reintroduces the mustard. Dark mode keeps the bright yellow; it is legal there. Hexes in this note omit the leading # on purpose so check_palette does not flag its own documentation.
